description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware updates and upgrades for Fortinet devices. It includes functions for byte swapping, block size conversions, building partition maps, updating firmware information, and performing the entire upgrade process by handling tar archives and MTD partitions.

methods.name: fortinet_bswap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a 32-bit value.

methods.name: fortinet_by2bl
methods.description: Converts a byte size to block count.

methods.name: fortinet_bl2by
methods.description: Converts block count to byte size.

methods.name: fortinet_build_partmap
methods.description: Builds partition map string based on new and old values.

methods.name: fortinet_update_fwinfo
methods.description: Updates firmware information in the 'firmware-info' partition.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full firmware upgrade process, extracting images and writing to device partitions.
